text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council to authorize the installation of all-way stop control at the intersection of Falkirk Street and Haddington Avenue. The installation of an all-way stop control is warranted and recommended to clearly establish right-of-way and enhance pedestrian and vehicular safety.
North York Community Council: 1. Authorized an all-way stop control at the intersection of Falkirk Street and Haddington Avenue.
